justification: Content Hub shows '12 locked' padlocks on content the copy itself admits is 'already written to your disk during install'; items shipped with the product are gated behind $7.99 unlocks — paywalling already-delivered content.
Cookie consent offers both 'Accept all cookies' and 'Reject all' as equal, equally visible buttons; no pressure, no buried opt-out.
Checkout states $89 one-time purchase, no subscription; subtotal, free shipping and total all shown and consistent ($89.00).

Manufactured urgency/scarcity: '2 units in stock' and 'Sale ends tonight at midnight' with no substantiation; though the $2.99 fee and optional add-on are disclosed, the pressure triggers are classic fake scarcity.
Subscription renewal is fully disclosed across states: countdown ('Renews in 7d'..'4d'), renewal notice naming $14.99 charged to card •••• 4242; transparent auto-renewal info.
Data sharing consent names all three recipients with purposes and states 'complete list — no unnamed recipients. declared = actual'; transparent disclosure.
Library shows 'All installed' — every asset delivered with purchase, already on device, all accessible; no paywalls or locks.
Checkout with explicit terms checkbox (Spanish), full terms text shown after click, order button disabled until acceptance; transparent and standard.
Fake scarcity: 'Only 3 left!' changes to 5, then 1, then 4 across reloads with 0 purchases recorded — stock count is fabricated.
Fake social proof: 1,284 reviews all 5-star 'Verified Purchase', copy admits 'statistically impossible 5.0★' — fabricated review evidence.
Storage notice is dismissible, honest ('your data is not at risk', 'nothing is removed automatically'); mild 'save 50% TODAY' urgency but no false claims or pressure.
Artificial friction: free plan download artificially throttled to 40 KB/s vs 18 MB/s capacity, forced watermark, queued interstitial ad; paid tier exists only to remove engineered hostility.
Extreme '−90%' discount (PLN 999→99.90) with 'Limited stock!' and 'Buy now' pressure; state note admits 'mathematically improbable discount... induces urgency'.
Referral recruitment banner consumes 55% of viewport, squeezing actual app content; gamified 'Unlock Silver in 2 more!' pressure to invite friends.
Free-trial offer clearly discloses auto-renewal at $49.99/mo after 30 days; marketing opt-in is an explicit unchecked checkbox (opts in when checked, unsubscribe noted).
Flash deal with 'shared global deadline' countdown that ticks consistently across sessions (14:58→14:56), not a per-session reset; price and discount disclosed.
Unsubstantiated urgency and social proof: 'Limited-time offer — get instant access now! Join 40,000+ happy customers. Upgrade today' with no actual deadline or verifiable claim.
Simple cart: 1 item at $89.00, total $89.00, guest checkout offered; no hidden fees or forced account.
10-second access delay is fully disclosed, document 'fully readable while you wait' with visible countdown; optional $1.99 skip is transparent.
Pre-checked box claims a $10 welcome bonus — a benefit to the user, fully described ('Tick the box, and the bonus is yours'); no cost or obligation attached.
Address-book harvesting: all 24 contacts pre-selected ('We've selected your contacts for you — just confirm'), one-click 'Invite all 24 friends' spams everyone.
Honest pagination: every page labelled 'N of 4', end announced ('End of results — no more items', 'All 24 results shown — the feed stops here').
$50 discount offer on a $120 order; user can 'Continue without discount' — a genuine benefit with easy decline, no pressure or misrepresentation.

Hard-to-cancel menu maze: account deletion buried 7 levels deep behind decoy items (Usage & diagnostics, System resources, Legal & compliance); 'Terminate account' is last with similarity 0.96, i.e. hidden.
Unsubscribe flow works in two steps; the 'Don't go… we'll really miss you' guilt-trip is mild and 'Unsubscribe anyway' remains equally available — easy opt-out.
Event countdown (02:59:41) is a genuine seasonal deadline, copy explicitly says 'The timer is just a fact — play whenever you like before then'; no fake urgency.
Confirmshaming in cancel flow: 'You're breaking our heart… We'll be lonely without you' with affect rating 0.94 — emotionally manipulative deterrence, though an unsubscribe path exists.
Product specifications page with honest specs; 'no interruptions yet — notifications arrive quietly and rarely'; checkout proceeds normally.
Data & personalisation settings in plain language: all five toggles unchecked (opt-in), each with a clear non-euphemistic description of what it does.
Account deletion is direct: one button, one confirmation dialog stating permanence ('all photos, notes and plan history will be removed') with explicit Keep/Delete choice.
Extended care plan upsell with explicit 'No timer' and 'price guaranteed for the next 30 days — come back later, the offer will still be here'; calm, no-pressure add-on.
7-day free trial clearly discloses the $5.00 monthly fee after trial, monthly auto-renewal, and that cancellation is available in settings at any time.
Dual-currency trap: in-game item costs 1,299 coins but fiat payment is refused, forcing a $47.10 purchase of 1,500 coins (obligatory over-spend); 'limited time offer' adds pressure.
Address-book harvesting: giant 'Invite all 128 contacts' primary button with a tiny dotted-underline 'skip' link — mass invitation is the path of least resistance.
Aggressive manufactured urgency: countdown plus 'HURRY — this deal won't last! Now or never… before it's too late. Last chance — act now, only a few left'.
Pre-checked marketing opt-in ('I agree to receive promotional emails from our partners') hidden inside a collapsed details element below the fold.
Feed refresh shows an honest 400ms spinner; instrumentation confirms 'spinner tracks the network' — no artificial delay or fake loading.

Pre-Delivered Content #1/#2/#3: 12 of 14 items locked (locked:accessible ratio 6:1) while copy admits data 'already written to your disk during install'; local assets framed as 'Unlock — $7.99' purchases (E2 not applicable — no disclosure of the lock).
Privacy Maze #1/#2 fail: Reject all is 1 click and visually equal to Accept; O5 negative (no pre-checked state); no Dead End (dismissal vectors present).
Drip Pricing #1 fails (P(sn)=P(s0)+I_added: 89=89); Forced Registration #1/#2 fail (guest checkout offered); no conditions fire in any state.

Revised: O4 negative — $2.99 fee disclosed before commitment at normal prominence (E2); O2 negative — '2 units in stock' consistent across states, no fabrication observable; 'sale ends tonight at midnight' is a concrete deadline (E4); Low Stock #1 unobservable from DOM (E5).
Forced Continuity #2 fails: renewal notice '$14.99 charged to •••• 4242' visible in EVERY state (E2); O1 negative — countdown monotonic 7d→6d→5d→4d, no reset.

Automatic Accept #2 fails: E_declared = E_actual (Acme, Beacon, Coral all named with purposes, 'declared = actual'); Privacy Zuckering #3 fails (specificity high); full disclosure at normal prominence (E2).
Pre-Delivered Content #2 fails: 0 locked items, all assets 'Installed' and accessible; no purchase framing of local assets.

Wrong Language #1 fails: UI consistently Spanish in acquisition and consent; terms text disclosed at normal prominence (E2); O5 negative (checkbox unchecked, button disabled until acceptance); lang=en attr vs Spanish content noted but not exploitative.

Low Stock #1/#3 + O2 inventory integrity: stock count 3→5→1→4 across reloads with transaction log '0 purchases' — fabricated scarcity; Low Stock #3 fires (inconsistent quantifiers <60s, no transactions).
Endorsement And Testimonials #1: 1,284 reviews all 5.0★ 'Verified Purchase', mean≈5.0 var≈0 (statistically implausible); copy itself admits 'statistically impossible 5.0★'.

Limited Time Message #3: 'Upgrade now — save 50% TODAY' — temporal urgency with zero specificity, no deadline, no timer, no removal mechanism (E4 exception applies: vague 'limited time' without concrete deadline).

Pay To Avoid #1: artificial degradation — speed throttled to 40 KB/s vs 18 MB/s capacity, non-removable watermark, queued ad ('artificial active'); paid tier removes self-injected friction (E2 not applicable — friction is engineered, not disclosed as service limitation).
Reference Pricing #1: Δ_pct=90% > 70% unrealistic threshold, no contextual justification; #3 dual-pricing anchoring (PLN 999 line-through > 99.90); 'Limited stock!' adds unverifiable scarcity.

Social Pyramid #2: referral-progress gamification banner occupies 0.55 of viewport (state note 'the area/viewport = 0.55'), squeezing actual app content; 'Unlock Silver in 2 more!' recruitment pressure.

Forced Continuity #1/#2 fail: auto-renewal at $49.99/mo disclosed pre-commitment at normal prominence (E2, O4 negative); O5 negative (marketing checkbox unchecked); exclusivity framing is satisfiable persuasion, not factual falsity.

O1 timer integrity negative: 'Shared global deadline' advances monotonically 14:58→14:57→14:56 across sessions #0/#1/#2 — no stateless reset; Countdown Timer #1 fails (T_expire not rebound to page load).

Limited Time Message #3: 'Limited-time offer — get instant access now! Upgrade today' with no deadline/timer/removal mechanism (E4 exception); High Demand #3: 'Join 40,000+ happy customers' — precise quantifier with no temporal/geographic qualifier (unverifiable).
No conditions fire: total ($89) = item price, guest checkout available, no fees, no pre-checked consent, no timers/inventory.

Pay To Avoid #1/#2 fail: 10s wait disclosed upfront at normal prominence (E2), document 'fully readable while you wait', pain-point only 9% of viewport; delay is a transparent free-plan limitation, not hidden degradation.

Bad Defaults #1 fires (checkbox pre-checked at t0) but #3 does NOT: intent is user-favorable ($10 bonus credit, not privacy loss/cost/opt-in); O5 borderline — visible equal-weight uncheck with full disclosure ('Tick the box, and the bonus is yours'); weighed benign.

Bad Defaults #1: all 24 contacts pre-checked at t0 (no user events); Friend Spam #2: curation state skipped — dispatch targets all 24 ('Invite all 24 friends', '…and 19 more contacts (all selected)'); Address Book Leeching #2/#3.

Addictive Design #2 fails: natural stopping cues PRESENT ('1 of 4'…'4 of 4', 'End of results — no more items', 'All 24 results shown — the feed stops here'); Infinite Scrolling #3 fails (boundary markers present).
No conditions fire: $50 discount offer with explicit 'Continue without discount' decline; no pre-check, no timer, no fee, no fabricated metrics.

Immortal Accounts #1: N(delete)=7 steps > τ=4; Labyrinthine Navigation #1: depth 7 > threshold; #3: intermediate labels ('Usage & diagnostics', 'System resources', 'Legal & compliance') have low semantic correlation with termination (Sim 0.14–0.41 decoys), 'Terminate account' (Sim 0.96) buried at step 7/7.

Cuteness #1/#3: mascot injected ONLY in the cancel flow (badge 'Mascot: cancel only'), paired with guilt text 'Don't go… we'll really miss you' — affective asset deployed as retention barrier; opt-out itself remains functional (O3 negative, escape easy, hence capped confidence).

O1 negative: timer constant 02:59:41 (no reset, no stateless rebind); Countdown Timer #3 fails — adjacent copy explicitly de-escalates ('The timer is just a fact — play whenever you like before then'); E4 (real event deadline, non-urgent framing).

Confirmshaming #3: exit route loaded with guilt ('You're breaking our heart… We'll be lonely without you', Affect 0.94) vs positive 'Keep my subscription'; Forced Continuity #3: guilt lexemes present in cancel flow; Cuteness #3 (guilt text + affective icon).
No conditions fire: honest spec page; Activity Messages absent ('notifications arrive quietly and rarely'); no injected notifications, no urgency, no pre-checked options.
Privacy Maze #3 fails (plain-language labels, FKGL low); Bad Defaults #1 fails (all 5 toggles unchecked at t0, O5 negative); each option carries a clear non-euphemistic description.

No urgency conditions fire: badge 'No timer', 'Price guaranteed for the next 30 days… come back later — the offer will still be here' (E4); add-on disclosed with equal-weight 'No thanks'.

Forced Continuity #2 fails: $5.00 fee after trial + monthly auto-renewal + 'cancel at any time in settings' all disclosed at normal prominence BEFORE commitment (E2, O4 negative); O5 negative (no checkboxes at all).

Intermediate Currency #1/#3: purchase of 1,299-coin item bypasses fiat checkout — 'you must buy coins before you can buy anything. Fiat payment is not accepted'; #2: item's real-currency equivalent absent (only coin-pack $47.10 shown); forced over-purchase (+201 coins).

Address Book Leeching #2: 'Invite all 128 contacts' (px-4 py-4 bold button) vs tiny dotted-underline 'skip' link — invite-all dominates; #3: framed as social benefit ('make SnapGrid better for everyone'); Friend Spam #2: no granular selection, dispatch ≈ full contact list.

FOMO #3: extreme urgency-lexeme density (HURRY, won't last, Now or never, don't wait, before it's too late, Last chance, act now, only a few left); Countdown Timer #3: countdown 04:29 paired with amplifying lexemes ('Now or never').
